The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: to press something away from you.

notes: While 'empujar' generally means to apply force to move something away, use 'empujón' (noun) when specifically describing the act of giving someone a shove.
Do not confuse 'empujar' with 'tirar' (to pull). They are opposites in terms of direction.
